from pathlib import Path
import re

path = Path("docs/assets/document.js")
js = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

# Fix the over-indented active section block: lines that have 8+ extra spaces inside IIFE
# Find from "Active section highlight" to "initHighlight" end
start = js.find("/* ---------- Active section highlight")
end = js.find("/* ---------- Back to top ---------- */")
if start < 0 or end < 0:
    raise SystemExit(f"markers {start} {end}")

block = js[start:end]
# Remove common extra indent of 8 spaces from each line of the block
fixed_lines = []
for ln in block.splitlines():
    if ln.startswith("        ") and not ln.startswith("  /*"):
        # active block was inserted with 8 spaces base from IIFE's 2 spaces... messy
        # Dedent by 6 spaces if line has heavy indent
        if ln.startswith("        "):
            # count leading spaces
            sp = len(ln) - len(ln.lstrip(" "))
            if sp >= 8:
                ln = ln[6:]  # pull back toward 2-space IIFE body
    fixed_lines.append(ln)
fixed = "\n".join(fixed_lines)
if not fixed.endswith("\n"):
    fixed += "\n"

js2 = js[:start] + fixed + js[end:]
path.write_text(js2, encoding="utf-8")

import subprocess
r = subprocess.run(["node", "--check", str(path)], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(r.returncode, r.stderr or "JS_OK")

# show snippet
text = path.read_text()
i = text.find("Active section highlight")
print(text[i:i+600])
